deadline.value: Apply by December 4, 2026, 8:59 pm Pacific, for Fall 2027 entry (fall intake only).
deadline.quote: The deadline to apply for Fall 2027 admission is 8:59pm PST on December 4th, 2026.

gre_subject.value: The Physics GRE Subject Test is required of all applicants for Fall 2027 (new this cycle).
gre_subject.quote: GREs (new for Fall 2027) | The Physics GRE Subject Test is required for all applicants.

supervisor.value: The astronomy pages checked do not say whether you must contact a supervisor before applying.

funding.value: Astronomy PhD students are supported by fellowships, teaching and research appointments that cover fees, nonresident tuition and a living stipend.
funding.quote: Astronomy graduate students are provided financial assistance in the forms of fellowships, teaching positions, and research appointments. This support is meant to cover costs such as registration costs (all fees and nonresident supplemental tuition) and provides a stipend for living expenses while attending Berkeley.

entry_route.value: Apply straight from a bachelor's degree (final-year students may apply); a master's is not required.
entry_route.quote: Expect to or hold a bachelor’s degree or recognized equivalent from an accredited institution.

notes: The program is the PhD in Astrophysics. The department's TOEFL (90) and IELTS (7) minimums match the Graduate Division's.
